title: Upper Savannah — F7 original annual estimates and published errors on retained tributary basins

scope.selection: Seven exact station/constituent/published-COMID matches to the retained P9 tributary selection; all eleven original F7 target rows remain context.
scope.spatial_dependence: Retain actual upstream-basin overlap groups; no station/constituent split may cross a leakage group
notes: F7 load/standard-error values retain kg/year. Existing observation parsing handles native comparison-unit conversion; no manual sediment conversion is applied here.
Existing P9 calibration scores, predictions, weights and holdout partitions remain unchanged. A source-error supplement is a distinct sensitivity product, not another fit.
Original station-specific sampling windows are retained in each complete source row and temporal_basis; the importer retains its original annual flow-support period fields.

records.comparability_note: A distinct F7DN436B source edition on the exact retained P9A682GW published-reach basin. Original final estimator, kg/year rate, paired standard error, flow-support dates and water-quality sampling-window fields remain unchanged. This is a long-term published annual estimate, not independent annual measurements or proof of same-DEM gauge drainage alignment. Original P9 results and held-out assignments remain historical; no replacement or refit is implied.
